<!-- All news items below this line -->{{Current events|year=2003|month=08|day=1|content=
* [[Mozdok truck bombing]]: A [[truck bomb]] destroys a military hospital in [[Mozdok]] in Southern Russia, near [[Chechnya]], killing 52 and wounding 82. The Russian government blames the attack on [[Second Chechen War|Chechen separatists]]. A media spokesman for rebel political leader, [[Aslan Maskhadov]], denied any connection with the incident.<ref>[https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/articles/A13500-2003Aug1.html ]{{dead link|date=September 2015}}</ref>
* [[North Korea]] agrees to multilateral talks in its [[North Korea nuclear weapons program|nuclear standoff]] with Japan, [[South Korea]], Russia, The United States, and the People's Republic of China.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.iht.com/articles/104953.html |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050209231417/http://www.iht.com/articles/104953.html |archive-date=2005-02-09 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* The Ministry of Social Affairs and Health plans to propose an amendment to Finnish [[tobacco]] legislation which would make retail sales of tobacco products subject to a license.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.helsinki-hs.net/news.asp?id=20030801IE4 |title=Finland |publisher=Helsinki-hs.net |date= |accessdate=2015-09-26}}</ref>
